reply_text: I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I can't set up the standing Monday 08:00 digest. My scheduled jobs run locally and their output isn't posted back into Slack, so nothing would appear on its own. I offered to write the "Coastal week ahead" digest by hand whenever she asks in the channel, drawing on #coastal-team, #coastal-random and the open customer items I can see. A fully automatic version would need whoever runs the workspace integrations.
